holdings.name: HDFC Bank Ltd

what_changed.text: HDFC Bank reported net profit of Rs 21,537 crore on revenue of Rs 95,132 crore for the quarter ended September 2026 [S2].
Kaizad Bharucha will cease to serve as Deputy MD on December 31, 2026 [S5].
The bank initiated an internal probe into an alleged data leak involving two senior executives [S20, S21, S23].

holdings.why_it_matters: At 5.66% of the portfolio, HDFC Bank is the fund's largest single holding and detracted -0.381% over the past 3 months as its share price dropped -6.73%.

watch.text: The bank faces an upcoming CEO transition and findings from the internal leak review [S19, S20].

holdings.name: Maruti Suzuki India Ltd

what_changed.text: Jun 2026 operating margin declined to 8% with net profit of Rs 3,447 crore [S8].
The ITAT issued an order granting Maruti Suzuki tax relief of approximately Rs 13,000 crore [S10, S28].
Maruti held entry-level car prices steady while reclaiming a 40% passenger vehicle market share in H1 FY27 [S26, S27].

holdings.why_it_matters: Maruti represents 4.10% of the fund and was the largest single negative contributor over 3 months, reducing fund returns by -0.675% on a -16.46% price drop.

watch.text: The board meets on October 27, 2026 to review Q2 FY2026 financial results [S12].

holdings.name: State Bank of India

what_changed.text: Net profit reached Rs 25,121 crore on revenue of Rs 136,240 crore for the quarter ended Jun 2026 [S14].
SBI reported dark-web exposure of 3,897 customer records while confirming that customer balances remain safe [S15, S34].

holdings.why_it_matters: Weighing 3.55% of the fund within Financials (30.6% fund share), SBI's -5.56% 3-month return added to overall sector drag.

watch.text: Regulatory and forensic assessments following the customer data exposure on the dark web [S15, S33].

holdings.name: Oracle Financial Services Software Ltd

what_changed.text: Jun 2026 revenue rose to Rs 3,125 crore with an operating margin of 60% and net profit of Rs 1,416 crore [S37].
Non-Executive Director Nian Nian Yuan resigned effective October 15, 2026 [S40, S41].
Shares dropped after Oracle invoked force majeure on a data centre project citing power delays [S57, S58].

holdings.why_it_matters: With a 3.46% weight in the 15.2% Technology allocation, OFSS declined -9.15% over 3 months, tempering broader tech returns.

watch.text: The board meets on October 23, 2026 to consider second-quarter and half-year financial results [S39].

holdings.name: INDO-MIM Ltd.

what_changed.text: Net profit for Jun 2026 was Rs 240 crore on sales of Rs 1,219 crore [S88].
The board approved establishing a wholly owned subsidiary in Vietnam with an investment of Rs 45 crore over five years [S89, S91].
The Ministry of Corporate Affairs formally updated the company's listing status following its exchange debut [S92].

holdings.why_it_matters: Accounting for 3.33% of the portfolio in Industrials (16.6% fund share), the stock fell -12.53% over the past month.

watch.text: Progress on setting up and funding the newly approved subsidiary in Vietnam [S89, S91].

holdings.name: Zomato Ltd

what_changed.text: Sep 2026 revenue climbed to Rs 24,138 crore with net profit of Rs 125 crore [S42].
B2C gross order value grew 54% year-over-year while adjusted revenue rose 76% in Q2 FY27 [S46].
The board approved restructuring the Going-out India business and an Adonmo-Mygate share swap valued at approximately Rs 156 crore [S44, S47].

holdings.why_it_matters: Holding a 3.28% portfolio weight, Zomato was the fund's second largest positive contributor over 3 months, providing +0.438% from a 13.36% share gain.

watch.text: Flipkart is piloting Eat-in by Minutes in Bengaluru to enter food delivery [S76, S80].

holdings.name: Hero Motocorp Ltd

what_changed.text: Jun 2026 net profit stood at Rs 1,418 crore on revenue of Rs 13,126 crore [S50].
Hero MotoCorp launched the Xtreme 160R 4V and updated Xtreme 250R, with customer deliveries scheduled for November 2026 [S53, S70].
Festive season volumes rose on EMI-driven consumer demand despite global supply chain hurdles [S73, S74].

expected.text: Citi raised its FY27 two-wheeler industry growth projection to 9% [S69].

holdings.why_it_matters: Represents 3.26% of the fund in Consumer Discretionary, posting a flat 0.72% gain over 3 months amid wider auto sector weakness.

watch.text: The board of directors is scheduled to meet on October 28, 2026 [S52].

holdings.name: Indusind Bank Ltd

what_changed.text: Sep 2026 net profit recovered to Rs 1,242 crore from a loss in the prior year period, as gross NPA declined to 2.73% [S93, S94, S105].
Quarterly earnings beat estimates as provisions declined sharply [S103, S107].
Priyanka Sinha was appointed as an independent director for four years [S94, S96].

holdings.why_it_matters: Holding a 2.97% fund weight, the stock detracted -0.48% over 3 months after falling -16.17%, ranking among the fund's top detractors.

watch.text: Sustainability of asset quality improvements following the reduction in gross NPA to 2.73% [S93].

holdings.name: Indus Towers Ltd

what_changed.text: Jun 2026 sales came in at Rs 8,431 crore with net profit of Rs 1,746 crore and an operating margin of 53% [S59].
The company scheduled an earnings conference call for October 28, 2026 [S60].

holdings.why_it_matters: At 2.86% of the fund, the position fell -3.70% over 3 months, reflecting subdued performance across telecom infrastructure assets.

watch.text: The board convenes on October 27, 2026 to approve Q2 and half-year FY26 financial results [S61].

holdings.name: One 97 Communications Ltd

what_changed.text: Jun 2026 sales reached Rs 2,448 crore with net profit rising to Rs 220 crore [S81].
NPCI deferred the rollout of MDR on select UPI P2M transactions until after Diwali [S85, S99].
Subsidiary FGTPL received a GST demand of Rs 703.66 crore for the period April 2018 to March 2023 [S84].

holdings.why_it_matters: Weighing 2.70%, One 97 Communications was the top positive contributor over 3 months, generating +0.70% to fund return via a 25.94% price rally.

watch.text: Board review of Q2 FY2027 results on October 26 and post-Diwali UPI MDR policy steps [S83, S85].

portfolio.statement: Kotak Multi Cap Fund posted a 3-month return of -4.11%, weighed down by Financials (30.6%) and Consumer Discretionary (12.9%) detractions despite strong gains from internet and fintech positions.
interp: Heavy allocations to large lenders and passenger auto names dragged performance, as HDFC Bank, IndusInd Bank, and Maruti Suzuki dropped sharply over 3 months.
High-momentum internet platforms Zomato and One 97 Communications provided substantial positive offsets, gaining 13.36% and 25.94% respectively.
portfolio.line: Automotive and banking weaknesses drove negative quarterly fund returns despite sharp fintech gains.

drivers.text: HDFC Bank and IndusInd Bank dropped -6.73% and -16.17% over 3 months amid leadership changes, data investigations, and prior asset quality issues [S5, S21, S93].
Maruti Suzuki retreated -16.46% in 3 months even after securing an ITAT tax relief order of approximately Rs 13,000 crore [S10, S28].
One 97 Communications rallied 25.94% as NPCI deferred UPI merchant MDR implementations until after Diwali [S85, S99].

themes.title: Digital Payments and Consumer Platforms
themes.text: Fast-growing internet and digital commerce models contributed positively to the portfolio, driven by order growth and regulatory breathing room on payments.

themes.title: Governance, Cybersecurity, and Bank Restructuring
themes.text: Major banking holdings faced operational scrutiny over data leaks and governance transitions even as underlying asset recovery progressed.

macro.factor: Automotive Demand and Input Cost Pressures
macro.why: Auto manufacturers balanced festive demand against compressed operating margins and supply chain friction.

macro.factor: Banking Regulatory Scrutiny and Information Security
macro.why: Lenders and financial intermediaries dealt with compliance probes, tax disputes, and dark-web customer data breaches.

priced_in.text: Maruti Suzuki's margin contraction to 8% in Jun 2026 has been digested following steady entry-car pricing [S8, S26].
IndusInd Bank's turnaround to a Rs 1,242 crore net profit with gross NPA dropping to 2.73% is already reported [S93, S94].

could_change.title: UPI MDR Implementation Post-Diwali
could_change.text: The timeline and structure of NPCI's decision on merchant discount rates for UPI transactions could directly alter revenue prospects for digital payment processors.

could_change.title: Banking Leadership Transition and Probe Outcomes
could_change.text: Resolution of executive data leak probes and incoming leadership handovers at major banks could reset investor sentiment in Financials.

portfolio.risk_note: Financials represent 30.6% of the portfolio, concentrating performance risk around corporate governance, data compliance reviews, and credit provisioning across leading public and private banks.
